text: みさきに　すんでる　ポケモン　マニアの　コレクション　みに　いこうと　おもってな！

structure.jp: みさきに　すんでる　ポケモン　マニアの　コレクション
structure.en: the collection of the Pokémon maniac who lives on the cape

structure.jp: みに　いこうと　おもってな！
structure.en: I was thinking I'd go see it!

patterns.name: 〜ようとおもう
patterns.span: いこうと　おもって
patterns.explanation: A verb in the 'I'll do it' form plus とおもう means 'I'm thinking of doing'. いこうと　おもって = 'I was thinking of going'.

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: A shortened verb plus に before a verb of going tells what you go there to do. みに　いこう = 'I'll go to see'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: みさきに　すんでる　ポケモン　マニア
patterns.explanation: The phrase ending in すんでる describes the person right after it. みさきに　すんでる　ポケモン　マニア = 'the Pokémon maniac who lives on the cape'.
